description: A photograph depicting a light green/beige coloured water body, identified as a lake or reservoir, nestled within a steep, rugged, and rocky mountainous landscape. A concrete dam structure is visible at the far end of the water body, spanning the valley. The surrounding slopes appear dry and sparsely vegetated. A prominent dashed red line traces the visible shoreline of the water body, indicating its boundary for classification purposes. This image serves as an example for classifying water bodies in a land cover/land use context, particularly those of artificial origin or associated with hydropower stations, as per the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines.
